blurb: Clearview Lanes offers bowling for all ages and skill levels, with family-friendly entertainment and food service at the lanes. They provide leagues, tournaments, and various special events including fundraisers and corporate parties. Attached to Hennigan's Restaurant, they offer dining options alongside bowling activities.
extraNote: Call ahead to confirm lane availability for Sunday $1.50 games · Fundraiser organizations must sell tickets; Clearview handles setup and cleanup
